description:
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Product Engineer (Tier 2 - Onsite) based in Chonburi Province to support Mass Production (MP) and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities across ODM, JDM and CM partners.

NVIDIA's Networking business unit has continuously reinvented itself over the past two decades. Our high-speed products are market leaders, driving innovation that delivers greater speed and bandwidth with each new generation. Today, we are increasingly recognized as the premier provider of end-to-end high-speed Ethernet and InfiniBand solutions.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Working as onsite engineer at our CM production site (Chonburi area main site) as Tier 2, traveling to other sites from time to time is required.
  • Act as Tier 2 technical support for manufacturing and production-related issues escalated from Tier 1 teams.
  • Lead root cause analysis and drives corrective actions for complex production, test and quality issues.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing readiness and production ramp activities.
  • Maintain and improve production infrastructure, test systems, tools and manufacturing processes.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and manufacturing partners to resolve technical issues and improve operational efficiency.
  • Drive yield improvement, cost reduction, process optimization and test capacity expansion initiatives.
  • Develop troubleshooting guides, training materials and knowledge-sharing processes to enhance Tier 1 capabilities.
  • Support qualification, deployment and validation of new hardware, software and manufacturing solutions.

 

 What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in product engineering, manufacturing engineering, test engineering, or related fields with hands-on experience in manufacturing or production environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills with experience using JMP or similar data analysis tools.
  • Experience with production test systems, manufacturing processes and hardware debugging.
  • Proficiency in Linux, Python, C++, automation, networking and data analysis tools.
  • Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal, leadership and team management skills with the ability to effectively lead and develop CM/ODM/JDM engineering teams.
  • Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 

Ways to Stand Out From the Crowd:

  • Experience with networking, optical transceiver or high-speed interconnect products.
  • Experience with manufacturing automation and production support tools.
